pool.text: People established the Port of Baltimore to support the tobacco trade.
The Town of Baltimore was established by the Province of Maryland.
The Maryland Jockey Club was formed as the nation's first professional sports organization.
Baltimore established its public market system across the developing settlement area.
Lexington Market was founded as a notable public market in America.
Baltimore pioneered the use of gas lighting in municipal infrastructure.
No Republican candidate has won election to the Baltimore City Council since this year.
The Harbor Tunnel opened to serve Interstate 895 within the local city limits.
The Shriver Hall Concert Series was founded to present classical chamber music.
The Baltimore Orioles baseball team won their first of three World Series titles.
The Baltimore riot occurred following the assassination of Martin Luther King Jr.
Pei's World Trade Center was constructed as an equilateral pentagonal building.
Baltimore hosted the first International Theater Festival featuring multiple performances.
The Baltimore Metro SubwayLink rapid transit line opened to connect downtown with northwest suburbs.
The Wheelabrator Baltimore incinerator began operating as a facility for waste-to-energy conversion.
The four-bore Fort McHenry Tunnel opened to provide motorist service along Interstate 95.
The Baltimore Sun newspaper was sold by its local owners to the Times Mirror Company.
Oriole Park at Camden Yards opened as a retro style baseball park.
Oriole Park at Camden Yards opened and became the home ballpark for the baseball team.
The Baltimore Light RailLink opened to run between northern and southern suburban communities.
